created_prompt: I want you to generate a plan over the next three years to grow my online following and publish a cookbook. I post cooking content online regularly featuring quick, healthy and delicious recipes and meals to 1.2M followers. I don't know if I should go the traditional route or bet on myself and self-publish. I work four days a week and my time and budget are limited. Show me a concrete plan that is actionable, clear and precise with milestones that will allow me to reach my goal.
